title: Échelle de classification de la continence de Wexner
formula:
Addition of the selected points:

| Type of incontinence | Frequency | Points |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Incontinence to solid stool | Never | 0 |
| Less than once a month | 1 | |
| Less than once a week but at least once a month | 2 | |
| Less than once a day but at least once a week | 3 | |
| At least once a day | 4 | |
| Incontinence to liquid stool | Never | 0 |
| Less than once a month | 1 | |
| Less than once a week but at least once a month | 2 | |
| Less than once a day but at least once a week | 3 | |
| At least once a day | 4 | |
| Incontinence to gas | Never | 0 |
| Less than once a month | 1 | |
| Less than once a week but at least once a month | 2 | |
| Less than once a day but at least once a week | 3 | |
| At least once a day | 4 | |
| Wears pad | Never | 0 |
| Less than once a month | 1 | |
| Less than once a week but at least once a month | 2 | |
| Less than once a day but at least once a week | 3 | |
| At least once a day | 4 | |
| Lifestyle alteration* | Never | 0 |
| Less than once a month | 1 | |
| Less than once a week but at least once a month | 2 | |
| Less than once a day but at least once a week | 3 | |
| At least once a day | 4 | |

*Defined in the original study only as "the extent to which it alters the patient's life".

how_to_use.pearls:
- Does not account for fecal urgency.
- Easily understood by patients.

next_steps.advice: Un interrogatoire ciblé doit être réalisé chez tout patient présentant une incontinence, quel qu'en soit le degré.

more_info:
Interprétation :

Les scores vont de 0 à 20, 0 indiquant une continence parfaite et 20 une incontinence complète.
medium_description: Stratifie la gravité de l’incontinence fécale.
